steps_basic.title: Create variables
steps_basic.instruction: Go to Variables and make two variables: 'secret' and 'guess' (both for all sprites).
steps_basic.hint: Variables → Make a Variable → type 'secret' → OK. Then make another called 'guess'.

steps_basic.title: Start the game
steps_basic.instruction: Add 'when green flag clicked' event block.
steps_basic.hint: Events category (yellow) → when green flag clicked

steps_basic.title: Pick random secret number
steps_basic.instruction: Set secret to a random number from 1 to 10 using 'pick random'.
steps_basic.hint: Variables → set [secret] to. Operators → pick random (1) to (10). Put them together.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))

steps_basic.title: Ask for a guess
steps_basic.instruction: Use 'ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait' to get the player's guess.
steps_basic.hint: Sensing → ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait

steps_basic.title: Store the guess
steps_basic.instruction: Set guess variable to (answer) to save what the player typed.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
set [guess v] to (answer)

steps_basic.title: Check if correct
steps_basic.instruction: Add 'if then' block. If guess = secret, say 'Correct!' for 2 seconds.
steps_basic.hint: Control → if then. Operators → (guess) = (secret). Looks → say [Correct!]
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
set [guess v] to (answer)
if <(guess) = (secret)> then
  say [Correct!] for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Give feedback if wrong
steps_basic.instruction: Add 'else' to the if block. Inside: if guess > secret say 'Too high!' else say 'Too low!'
steps_basic.hint: Click + on if block to add else. Nest another if inside for high/low check.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
set [guess v] to (answer)
if <(guess) = (secret)> then
  say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
else
  if <(guess) > (secret)> then
    say [Too high!] for (2) seconds
  else
    say [Too low!] for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Test the game
steps_basic.instruction: Click green flag and try guessing 3 times. Do you get correct feedback? Basic complete!
steps_basic.hint: Try guessing high, low, and correct to see all three messages.

steps_standard.title: Start with Basic code
steps_standard.instruction: Great! Standard level adds limited tries. Make sure your Basic code works: secret number, ask, check, feedback.
steps_standard.hint: You should have the basic guessing game working with high/low/correct feedback.

steps_standard.title: Create tries variable
steps_standard.instruction: Make a new variable called 'tries' (for all sprites).
steps_standard.hint: Variables → Make a Variable → type 'tries' → OK

steps_standard.title: Set starting tries
steps_standard.instruction: After setting secret, add 'set tries to (5)' to give the player 5 attempts.
steps_standard.hint: Variables → set [tries] to (5). Put it right after set secret.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
set [tries v] to (5)

steps_standard.title: Loop until tries run out
steps_standard.instruction: Wrap the ask+check part inside 'repeat until <(tries = 0) OR (guess = secret)>'.
steps_standard.hint: Control → repeat until. Operators → ( ) OR ( ), ( ) = ( ). Condition: tries=0 or guess=secret
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
set [tries v] to (5)
repeat until <<(tries) = (0)> or <(guess) = (secret)>>
  ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
  set [guess v] to (answer)
  if <(guess) = (secret)> then
    say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
  else
    if <(guess) > (secret)> then
      say [Too high!] for (2) seconds
    else
      say [Too low!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Decrease tries after wrong guess
steps_standard.instruction: Inside the 'else' part (wrong guess), add 'change tries by (-1)' after the feedback.
steps_standard.hint: Variables → change [tries] by (-1). Put it at the end of the else block.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
set [tries v] to (5)
repeat until <<(tries) = (0)> or <(guess) = (secret)>>
  ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
  set [guess v] to (answer)
  if <(guess) = (secret)> then
    say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
  else
    if <(guess) > (secret)> then
      say [Too high!] for (2) seconds
    else
      say [Too low!] for (2) seconds
    change [tries v] by (-1)

steps_standard.title: Show win or lose message
steps_standard.instruction: After the repeat loop: if guess = secret say 'You win!' else say 'Game over. Secret was (secret)'.
steps_standard.hint: Use join to combine text with the secret number: join [Secret was ] (secret)
steps_standard.blocks_text:
after repeat loop:
if <(guess) = (secret)> then
  say [You win!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (join [Game over. Secret was ] (secret)) for (3) seconds

steps_standard.title: Show tries on stage
steps_standard.instruction: Check the box next to 'tries' variable to display it on stage. Test both winning and losing!
steps_standard.hint: Click checkbox next to tries in Variables category to show/hide on stage.

steps_advanced.title: Start with Standard code
steps_advanced.instruction: Awesome! Advanced level adds difficulty settings, hints, and best score tracking.
steps_advanced.hint: You should have: limited tries, win/lose messages, tries counter on stage.

steps_advanced.title: Create maxNum variable
steps_advanced.instruction: Make a variable called 'maxNum' (for all sprites). This controls difficulty.
steps_advanced.hint: Variables → Make a Variable → type 'maxNum' → OK

steps_advanced.title: Ask difficulty level
steps_advanced.instruction: At the start, ask 'Choose difficulty: easy, medium, or hard' and wait for answer.
steps_advanced.hint: Put this right after green flag, before setting secret.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
ask [Choose difficulty: easy, medium, or hard] and wait

steps_advanced.title: Set maxNum based on difficulty
steps_advanced.instruction: Use if-then: if answer='easy' set maxNum to 10, if 'medium' set to 50, if 'hard' set to 100.
steps_advanced.hint: Three if-then blocks checking answer against 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
ask [Choose difficulty: easy, medium, or hard] and wait
if <(answer) = [easy]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (10)
if <(answer) = [medium]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (50)
if <(answer) = [hard]> then
  set [maxNum v] to (100)

steps_advanced.title: Use maxNum for secret
steps_advanced.instruction: Change 'set secret to pick random 1 to 10' to use maxNum: pick random 1 to (maxNum).
steps_advanced.hint: Replace the (10) with the maxNum variable block.

steps_advanced.title: Add even/odd hint when tries=2
steps_advanced.instruction: Inside the repeat loop, check if tries=2. If yes, check if secret is even/odd and say the hint.
steps_advanced.hint: Use (secret) mod (2) = 0 for EVEN, otherwise ODD. Operators → ( ) mod ( )
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
inside repeat loop, after wrong guess:
if <(tries) = (2)> then
  if <((secret) mod (2)) = (0)> then
    say [Hint: It's EVEN!] for (2) seconds
  else
    say [Hint: It's ODD!] for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Create bestScore variable
steps_advanced.instruction: Make a variable 'bestScore'. Set it to 999 when green flag clicked (before difficulty question).
steps_advanced.hint: Variables → Make Variable → 'bestScore'. Set to high number so any score beats it.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestScore v] to (999)

steps_advanced.title: Track best score when winning
steps_advanced.instruction: When player wins, calculate guessCount = 5 - tries + 1. If guessCount < bestScore, update bestScore.
steps_advanced.hint: After 'You win!' message: set guessCount to ((5)-(tries)+(1)). Check if better than bestScore.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
if player wins:
set [guessCount v] to ((5) - (tries) + (1))
if <(guessCount) < (bestScore)> then
  set [bestScore v] to (guessCount)
  say (join [New best! Only ] (join (bestScore) [ guesses!])) for (3) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Add Restart button (optional)
steps_advanced.instruction: Create a button sprite. When clicked, broadcast 'RESTART'. On receive RESTART, reset variables and start over.
steps_advanced.hint: New sprite → paint a button → when clicked → broadcast RESTART. Main code → when I receive RESTART → reset all
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
Button sprite:
when this sprite clicked
broadcast [RESTART v]

Main sprite:
when I receive [RESTART v]
set [bestScore v] to (999)
[then run the whole game code again]

steps_advanced.title: Test all features
steps_advanced.instruction: Test easy/medium/hard modes, get the hint at 2 tries left, and try to beat your best score! Advanced complete!
steps_advanced.hint: Make sure difficulty changes the range, hint appears, and best score saves.
